about: Viewpoints: where the game is set against the real Braga (task 001). Metres from the Praça da República, x east, z south, y above elev0 (154 m). name is in English and nome in Portuguese, for the scorecard (task 003). The camera at (x, y, z) looks at (tx, ty, tz); fov is its vertical field of view in degrees. surface is what the photo was taken from, and what the camera stands on in the tiles (task 058): lane (a carriageway, half a car's width in from its edge at least), pavement (a pavement, or a central reservation or an island beside the carriageway), path (a footway, a path or a cycleway) or ground (none of those: a square, a park). Where Mapillary's position puts it off that surface, the camera is moved the shortest way onto it, in a lane to the middle of the lane the photo shows, its target with it so its heading and pitch stay, and its notes say how far. route: false marks a kart's view the race no longer passes, on a street of the open world (task 047). photo is the real one from the same place: its source, author, licence and link, and the camera that took it (lat, lon, heading, pitch and roll in degrees). Fetch the photos with node tools/refs.mjs.

Mapillary says the camera looked at 139°; the game frames what the photo shows at 100° (the buildings outlined from it with tools/buildings.mjs mark): the hall's west face with the α on the right, the buildings north of it on the left. Moved 3.7 m onto the path, off the verge where Mapillary puts it (task 058).

viewpoints.name: The Capela de Santo Adrião, up its bank from the road
viewpoints.nome: A Capela de Santo Adrião, no alto do talude, da estrada

Aimed at 206° and 5° up, where the photo frames the chapel and the road, not at Mapillary's 186.8°, the phone's compass; 2.5 m north of where Mapillary puts it, in the road as the photo is.

dropped.name: Avenida João XXI
dropped.dropped: 2026-10-18, task 052 (the owner's answer): its camera stood on the map's median hedge, which the streets now give way to. Kept for where its photo was taken (the facades seen in it, refs/buildings.json) and its earlier rounds on the scorecard; no longer shot.
